title: Zou et al. (2022): casein-stabilized MnO2 quantum dots from aqueous permanganate
method: Aqueous protein-directed permanganate reduction at room temperature

sources.title: Ingenious Multifunctional MnO2 Quantum Dot Nanozymes with Superior Catechol Oxidase-like Activity for Highly Selective Sensing of Redox-Active Dopamine Based on an Interfacial Passivation Strategy
sources.authors: Wenting Zou; Yan Liu; Renjie Li; Rong Guo
sources.main_status: All eleven main-article pages read and visually checked; pages 2–4 contain the scoped synthesis route and linked Figures 1–2 product characterization. Pages 5–8 concern catalysis and dopamine-treated specimens; pages 9–11 contain SI notice, authors and references.
sources.si_status: Matching SI not admitted in the screened-pass manifest; not used or reviewed. Main article does not require SI for the scoped synthesis value.
sources.reuse_status: Exact selected source crops are privately staged for user-directed display; publisher permission unverified.
